sections.heading: Why Karnataka Businesses Are Switching to RCS Messaging

blocks.html: Karnataka is one of India's most digitally active states, and its businesses feel the limits of plain SMS every day: no branding, no media, no interactivity, and rising competition in a crowded inbox. RCS Business Messaging fixes that — it keeps the universal, app-free reach of SMS but adds a verified brand identity and an app-like experience inside the messaging app customers already use.

From the technology corridors of Bengaluru to the retail and services hubs of Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi and Belagavi, companies are adopting RCS for promotions, order updates, appointment reminders and support — on a smartphone base that is overwhelmingly Android, exactly where RCS shines. With Jio, Airtel and Vi all backing the channel and Apple adding RCS support in iOS 18, the reach keeps widening.

blocks.html: RCS (Rich Communication Services) is the modern messaging standard built into the default Messages app on Android, and now on iOS 18. Unlike plain SMS, RCS supports branded sender profiles, high-resolution images and video, product carousels, suggested replies and action buttons — without asking the customer to download anything. For businesses, that means a richer, measurable, two-way channel that still reaches the phone's native inbox.

sections.heading: RCS Compliance and Customer Consent in India

blocks.html: RCS is a permission-based channel, and getting compliance right protects both your brand reputation and your sender rating. In India, that means verified-sender registration, clear customer opt-in, easy opt-out, and DPDP-aligned data handling — the standards that keep your messaging trusted in 2026.
Because RCS falls back to SMS, your SMS layer must also stay DLT-compliant under TRAI rules. Ojiva AI builds consent and compliance into the workflow so you're covered end to end.

items.a: RCS (Rich Communication Services) is the upgrade to SMS built into the native Messages app on Android and iOS 18. It adds verified branding, images, video, carousels and tappable buttons, turning plain texts into interactive, app-like experiences with no app download required.

items.q: Is RCS available on all phones in Karnataka?
items.a: RCS works on most modern Android phones across Jio, Airtel and Vi, and on iPhones running iOS 18 where the carrier has enabled it. For any device that isn't RCS-ready, Ojiva AI automatically falls back to SMS, so every customer is still reached.

items.q: How is RCS different from SMS and WhatsApp?
items.a: SMS is universal and works offline but is text-only with no branding. WhatsApp is rich and conversational but needs the WhatsApp app. RCS brings rich, branded, interactive messaging into the phone's default inbox with no extra app, and falls back to SMS when a device isn't supported.

items.q: How much does RCS messaging cost in Karnataka?
items.a: RCS costs more per message than plain SMS because it carries media, interactivity and verified identity, but it usually delivers more value per rupee on high-intent campaigns. Pricing depends on message type, volume and fallback usage. Contact Ojiva AI for a rate based on your volume.

items.q: How do I get a verified RCS sender for my business in Karnataka?
